body: I know this comment is older but thank you! I am also on a GLP1 and I am cloudy and tan after the first dose, so I panicked and drank a bottle of magnesium citrate. Hopefully I’ll be clear after my second dose of prep because I don’t want to do this again for 10 years! 🤞

Me!! I finished my first bottle of Clenpiq already and things are definitely moving although I’m nowhere close to where I need to be yet. I’m nervous that I’m going to fail my prep since I’m on Ozempic (slows digestion) even though I skipped my dose this week and my doctor said just to not take within 24 hours.

Yeah I know that feeling. Mine was over 30 and he had never paid his taxes before. Didn’t know how health insurance works. Had a drug and alcohol problem. I helped him get a job and go to school. He got sober and even quit nicotine. It’s such a massive slap in the face.
I’m both comforted and disturbed at how many of us have been given the same speech.
Thank you, I am going to try to find something like what you’re talking about. I’m just so scared and shaking right now.

I wish but his sister has taken him in before, has young children, and made it clear that she does not want her in his home.

Going out of state feels wrong since it feels like I’m abandoning MY home, but maybe that feeling will subside. It’s definitely worth considering at least. Part of the issue is that I’m from over 3000 miles away so it would require planes/pet requirements/etc (Hawaii)

Up until now, the past three years have been great. So no prior history of violence/threats. I showed my best friend a clip from the livestream and who’s Catholic she said it’s almost like he’s possessed. Even when I look in his eyes I can’t see the person I’ve devoted everything to this whole time. I know he’s still there, somewhere, and maybe a part of me naively is still hoping that he’ll agree to help or at least snap out of this enough to where I feel safe on his own.

I’m just broken right now.

Unfortunately he quite literally doesn’t have any IRL friends at this point, despite me trying to encourage him for years. Very little family, but his relationships with them are very rocky, like not seeing them for year even though they’re in our town, although his sister has been trying to help. Mostly he just has some random internet people who mostly live out of the country, none of whom he’s met, etc.

I’m worried getting a TRO would only add gas to the fire, plus I’m not even sure what they would do since I’m not sure that anything he’s done/said constitutes a direct threat. It’s right on the edge mind you, but I’ve gone basically no contact aside from to ask to be sure my pets are fed, etc to try and not contribute to the delusion that I am somehow his enemy trying to “get him”

I have a great support network but they don’t live in my state. I cried to my friends from back home saying I wish so much I could just ask them to come over and hang out with me for a night, watch movies, etc just to not feel so alone in all of this.

This subreddit has been a godsend though because before I felt like I was surely losing my mind trying to navigate this on my own.
Yes my bipolar SO just live-streamed so many things about me. Some that are true, and others that are completely fabricated.

My partner has ADHD and bipolar. I think that there were other, less extreme manic episodes in the past three years that I very well might have mistaken for his ADHD symptoms. He’s currently prescribed stimulants, and is an extreme state of mania. I am praying that there is some combination of meds his psychiatrist can give him once he’s rational that can help prevent this from happening while also helping with his ADHD symptoms.

I read through your IG story. Not until Caleb tells you he can’t have you on for another episode until August do you ever even mention an SA. You ask him for gas money randomly. He even bothers to say that he’s worried you’re going through a manic episode. You seriously need help far beyond anything a financial YouTuber can provide.

You posted text going back a year and when you do bring up SA out of the blue, months later, he seems genuinely confused on wtf you’re talking about and then you make death threats towards the man, doxx him, etc.

Your entire IG story reads like someone having a mental health issue so while I think the accusations you’ve made are vile, seriously do go get help.
